request  r-0000001  GET /v1/list?prefix=%2Fservices%2F&limit=500  503
error[ZC-E0107]: can't listen on the server's address
  cause  can't listen on 127.0.0.1:7070: another process is already listening on
         it
  reqid  r-0000001
  fix    listen on another port
         or stop the other process   ss -ltnp | grep 7070
  more   zcube explain E0107
  docs   https://zigbox.github.io/zigcube/errors/E0107.html
